summary: The note describes a series of fall 2023 art events in a local city, centered on the 10th Riverbank Arts Festival at Barnes Park, themed "Bridges of Expression." It covers workshops, social-commentary exhibits, a youth showcase, culinary, digital and market events, a collaborative mosaic project, school outreach, and a closing light show on October 29th. The emphasis is on art education, community engagement, diversity and supporting local artists.
one_line: Overview of the 10th Riverbank Arts Festival and related fall 2023 events promoting art education, diversity, and community engagement.
key_facts: The community's art festivals and events run from September 5th to October 29th, 2023.
The Riverbank Arts Festival is held at Barnes Park from September 5th to 10th and is celebrating its 10th year.
Elena Martinez, the festival's creative director, chose the 2023 theme "Bridges of Expression" and the festival has over 200 exhibiting artists.
Workshops include Robert Hanley's beginner-friendly "The Landscape in Your Palm" and visiting Spanish sculptor Lucia Gomez's "Shape and Form: A Sculptural Journey."
"Voices on Canvas" on September 15th is led by art collective Resonate Arts and addresses equality, sustainability, and community development.
The "Emerging Visions" showcase on September 20th features high school and college student art and is coordinated by art teacher Sarah O'Connell.
"Culinary Canvas" runs September 22nd to 24th and features local chefs such as Dante Ramirez.
"Digital Frontiers" is curated by tech-art entrepreneur Kimberly Chen and uses VR installations, interactive projections, and live digital art demonstrations.
The Art Market runs from September 28th to October 2nd, letting local artists sell original work.
The "Mosaic Project," facilitated by mixed-media artist Jason Li, runs October 5th to 11th and combines small contributed artworks into one larger piece.
Throughout September and October the festival partners with local schools for traveling exhibitions, lecture series by professional artists, and student-led art initiatives.
The closing ceremony on October 29th features an elaborate light show with live music.
